name: Multi-Source Research Synthesis
description: Parallel research from multiple sources with intelligent fusion

tasks.prompt: Search the web for latest developments in AI agent orchestration (2024-2025). Find 5 key articles, papers, or announcements. Summarize findings.
Search X/Twitter for recent discussions about AI agent orchestration. Find thought leaders and key insights. Summarize community sentiment.
Search GitHub for trending repositories related to AI agent orchestration. Find top 5 projects by stars/activity. Summarize approaches.
Search for recent research papers (2024-2025) on AI agent orchestration, multi-agent systems, parallel LLM execution. Summarize academic progress.
Synthesize findings from all parallel research streams (web, X, GitHub, papers). Identify: 1) Market gaps, 2) Technical trends, 3) Opportunities for innovation. Create comprehensive research report.
